entries.en: Hmph, such humiliation...
For such a thing to happen again...
Are you saying you'll succumb to such[n]barbarism again...!
...I wish to know the true meaning of[n]this behavior.
Do you seek friendly competition with a[n]beloved neighbor? Or have you come to[n]destroy a hated foe?
You're a beloved neighbor.
You're a loathsome foe.
You sound preachy.
...That is a good attitude. Undoubtedly,[n]it will please our Father as well.
I see. You show no leniency even to[n]those beloved. Do not forget to be[n]strict on yourself as well...
Petty words... will not quell this tide.[n]Our Father cannot be deceived.
To call the exercise of excessive power[n]"competition"... It seems a convenient[n]phrasing, does it not?
To despise me is to despise our Father.[n]I want to make that clear.
One can honor even an enemy as a[n]worthy opponent... Such virtue is a gift[n]our Father gave to mankind...
If so, then I can understand these[n]events. I am grateful for your reply.
You see me as an opponent worthy of[n]such resolve? I shall take that as praise.
Do not speak such denouncements[n]before thinking. Your attitude only[n]serves to separate you from bliss.
Man's view is narrow; self-study has its[n]limits. It would please me if my words[n]prove edifying to you.
"The best medicine tastes bitter."[n]Those are the words of Man. Take[n]my words now as such medicine.
My word is the word of our Father.[n]I want to make that clear.
Hmph, so you are continuing this[n]behavior even now? What a[n]strong-willed human.
Children of the same Father have no[n]need for words... is it? A beautiful[n]expression, for a human.
Human who cannot grasp my query's[n]aim, know that our Father extends His[n]benevolence, even to you.
My inquiry is the inquiry of our Father.[n]I want to make that clear.
...You have already committed[n]a grave sin.
Do you know what I speak of?
Sin...?
Please tell me.
I've done nothing wrong.
Ahh, you are close to understanding. To[n]act without recognizing sin... is itself sin.
Does my reprimand truly trouble you[n]so...? Good. To be human is to suffer.
Worship our Father. Spend your[n]remaining years humbly. That will[n]serve as atonement for this sin.
...Acknowledge that you have sinned.[n]If you do not, you shall continue to sin[n]through life.
To pursue an understanding of good[n]and evil is looked upon favorably. Our[n]Father will be pleased, too.
You ask because you have divined my[n]meaning. Reflecting upon your actions[n]shows an admirable dedication.
One's own sins yield one's own[n]enlightenment: this is Man. Proud[n]human... transcend your ignorance.
Habitual dependence is an issue in[n]and of itself. You should give it ample[n]thought on your own.
Humans are born into sin. Know the[n]presence of our Father's divine blessing.
The youthful inability to recognize sin...[n]It seems Man still requires our Father's[n]benevolence.
Foolish Man who has forgotten his[n]awareness of sin. You dare disgrace[n]the name of our Father?
...Boldly stated, human. That artless[n]behavior makes a favorable impression.
I take it this erratic behavior is born[n]of a nascent cognizance of sin. Such[n]self-reproach is good.
I had not even imagined such a[n]response. I suppose you are the[n]type of human known as "unique."
You cannot extinguish your sins with[n]gunfire. Man speaks well when he says[n]"sin begets sin."
To assault me is to bear enmity toward[n]our Father. It seems you have added[n]another sin.
There is something you must do, and it[n]is not my murder...
It is to become aware of the gaze of[n]our Father, who watches over you[n]with loving grace.
I don't understand.
I feel his gaze.
I prefer a harsher stare.
Why did our Father grant you "free will"?[n]It seems an excessive boon, does it not?
First, you must have a willingness to[n]understand. Surely you can do this,[n]as sagacious as you are.
There is no need to be hasty. Our[n]Father is evenhanded in His mercy.
If you would go to such lengths to prove[n]a point, you should apply that same[n]obstinacy toward understanding.
A good sign, for the distance between[n]you and our Father is the distance you[n]must cross to reach peace.
Those words... Even if it is but your[n]imagination, I look favorably upon[n]your willingness to understand.
Cease your falsehoods. Those words[n]only serve to further debase you.
You, who commit such folly, dare speak[n]of our Father? What an inflated sense of[n]self-importance.
Then imagine how you might be viewed[n]if you were to murder me.
Rest assured, there is both warmth and[n]severity in our Father's gaze...
Gentle or harsh, it is up to our Father.[n]The choice is certainly not one to be[n]made by the likes of you.
Austerity is a favorable trait, especially[n]when directed toward the self.
...Ha. You missed. I shall propose a[n]favorable interpretation: it shows[n]your sense of self-reproach.
Haha, are you wavering? Our Father is[n]watching you at all times.
If you have the time to enact such dire[n]assault, use it instead to reflect upon[n]your actions.
All you are doing here is averting your[n]eyes from the truth.
Even at this hour, our merciful Father[n]may grant you forgiveness.
Vow that you will use that power in the[n]name of our Father.
I'll think about it.
No need to be so dramatic.
I decline.
Unable to act, despite knowing the[n]righteous path... Our Father exists to[n]guide such frailty.
Let us regard favorably the mere[n]indication of comprehension. Bid[n]farewell to your abhorrent past.
That power is a boon from our Father.[n]Yet, I sense pride within your words.[n]Am I mistaken?
Do not equivocate... Even our Father's[n]leniency has limits.
Misuse of great power degenerates[n]to mere violence. I am sure you[n]understand, sagacious as you are.
I am saying this for your sake. Eternal[n]benevolence begins with love and[n]respect for our Father.
Man, who cannot wield the power he[n]has obtained himself. I pray such pride[n]does not bring ruin.
I seek not your opinion. Know that my[n]warning is that of our Father, Himself.
To refuse our Father's mercy... You are[n]as a serpent in the garden—the very[n]fallen one himself.
It seems your will has not grown along[n]with your body. May our Father show[n]mercy on pitiable Man.
The power to wield our Father's gift of[n]language... Is mastery too heavy a[n]cross to bear?
Doubt, deliberation... These too are trials[n]from our Father. If so, will they not bring[n]you growth?
That is right. Use that power to strike[n]down the adversaries of our Father.
I know that you have exceptional power.[n]All that remains is to aim it at the proper[n]enemy.
I will make this clear. Even with the[n]power you hold, you are no match[n]for our Father.
You have not obtained that power on[n]your own. Know it exists solely because[n]our Father allows it.
...To behave in such a way, there must be[n]something in this world that is troubling[n]you.
...Very well. In the place of our Father,[n]I shall listen to your complaints.
Why can't we end war?
No complaints here.
I can't get a girlfriend.
Rise up and extol thine enemy. These[n]acts are significant, and your growth[n]pleases our Father.
Amid all creation, only Man wages such[n]wanton wars. Your very query forms a[n]total repudiation of Man.
Impudent Man, who has forgotten our[n]Father's mercy. Your excessive power is[n]the cause of such misery.
If all humanity united under the name[n]of our Father, then that strife would be[n]but a dream.
Hmhm... You bear your grievances so[n]stoically. I suppose that is preferable to[n]one who only complains.
Then what is it that inspires your[n]behavior? I struggle to understand.
You need not struggle to contain all your[n]frustrations within. Please, speak frankly[n]and plainly with me.
No human is without complaints. You[n]must learn to be more honest.
Humans who remember gratitude for[n]our Father are beautiful. No one can[n]ignore such appeal.
The more you desire, the further it[n]retreats... Selflessness brings your[n]wishes closer to fruition.
You lack the appeal worthy of such an[n]endeavor. Yes, begin by admonishing[n]yourself.
Such servility for a child of our[n]magnificent Father... Have the[n]demons already corrupted you?
Do you wish to solve your problems on[n]your own? Your initiative does make a[n]favorable impression.
Your troubles appear quite deeply[n]rooted. All the more reason to express[n]gratitude to our Father.
Desperation leads but to a destructive[n]end. Recall your gratitude to our Father[n]at once.
...Violence toward me is violence toward[n]our Father Himself. Reflect upon these[n]words at once.
...I am under the protection of our[n]magnificent Father.
Therefore, I cannot be destroyed. Desist[n]from this pointlessness.
What are you talking about?
That's absurd.
Then I shall desist.
Haha, that is fine... You lent me your ear.[n]That attitude means you have already[n]forsaken conflict.
Compassion exists because we keep love[n]and respect in our hearts. Our Father is[n]watching you, too.
Enmity toward me is enmity toward our[n]Father Himself. You should be sagacious[n]enough to fear that.
What is important is not language[n]comprehension, but rather the[n]contemplation of our Father.
Haha, that is good... Fearing me...[n]It serves as the impetus for you to[n]know the majesty of our Father.
You and I both exist beneath our[n]magnificent Father. Know that this[n]struggle itself serves no purpose.
That very comment underlines your[n]doubt. You achieve naught but exposing[n]your own weakness...
The depth of my adoration for our[n]Father... It far surpasses the boundaries[n]of your imagination.
A wise course of action. Our Father shall[n]forgive you as well.
Good. Let the thought of striking me[n]down pass from your mind.
Interesting. So that was the extent of[n]your resolve.
You do not decide whether or not I am[n]"saved"... The decision is our Father's[n]alone.
Haha, that is enough... I am not your[n]enemy, and more importantly, neither[n]is our Father.
Please, I hope we can reach a verbal[n]understanding... Violence saddens our[n]Father.
...I dare say that you intended to miss,[n]but this too is the work of our Father's[n]divine assistance.
Venturing to succeed in your pointless[n]crusade... Such folly casts a pall upon[n]our Father.
...I fear you may have gone astray. Our[n]Father prays you return to the righteous[n]path.
Let me hear you utter words of[n]repentance.
Sorry.
"Words of repentance."
Not sorry.
Such splendid obedience. Surely, this[n]will please our Father.
If that was your true mind, you would[n]say so without prompting. Give thanks[n]to our Father.
Now, recognize your wretchedness, for[n]in truth you have saddened our Father.
Apologetic words, they profess an[n]acquiescence to punishment. I saw[n]this acceptance within you.
To commit such mischief with the[n]language our Father provided! The[n]expression itself is unique.
That is not what I meant...
Our Father sees through shallow[n]words and equivocation.
You seem to express penitence, yet[n]you show no remorse. Your words are[n]the epitome of human foolishness.
I speak for our Father Himself, yet[n]you have the temerity to respond[n]with those childish words?
Haha, you are like an infant who just[n]learned speech. But human life itself[n]is a mere blink of an eye to me.
You have been granted permission[n]to apologize—not to choose.
Our Father is kind and tolerant;[n]there is value in a human like you[n]rehabilitating.
That gunfire... it is your cry for help.[n]Repent and events like these will not[n]occur a second time.
Doubt is fleeting, but the reality of sin is[n]eternal. I do not want you amassing such[n]transgressions.
I take it that you have no intention of[n]apologizing. Does it not pain you to[n]sadden our Father so?
You prefer to let your gun do the talking,[n]do you? How quintessentially human,[n]that vulgar manner of speech.
Know that your actions are at once your[n]own and those of Man.
To view me as an enemy is to incur[n]our Father's wrath. Man's future rests[n]in your hands.
Leave the future to me.
I need your guidance.
I don't get it.
What future can be trusted to one who[n]endangers others so?
Spoken with such clarity... Your resolve[n]is most convincing indeed.
One foolish man is capable of[n]eradicating Mankind. Can you[n]understand if I phrase it thusly?
No man will follow you as you are now.[n]Do you truly have any self-awareness?
Indeed, humility is the key to opening[n]the way to the future...
The Creator is also the Destroyer. It is for[n]your own benefit that you understand[n]our Father's glory.
In that case, you must first repent for[n]your past behavior...
Do not mistake dependence for any[n]absolution. You must take responsibility[n]for your own actions.
First, prepare in yourself a place[n]conducive to understanding. You[n]have not yet reached this place.
You have my word; this is no attempt at[n]deception. Treat it as a lesson of the path[n]of mankind.
Join hands with me in worship of our[n]Father... That is all that is being asked[n]of you.
You lack understanding because you[n]lack capability. First, realize your own[n]powerlessness.
Your actions now will bear the burden of[n]Man's future. Live each day in earnest[n]contemplation.
...Continue to hold the name of our[n]Father in your heart, and you can bid[n]farewell to useless agony.
If our Father brings down His hammer[n]of judgment, you will suffer the wrath[n]of all Mankind.
You are not worthy of our Father's[n]love; you are completely irredeemable,[n]child of Man.
...Now, allow me to ask this plainly.
Can you sacrifice yourself in order to[n]demonstrate your veneration of our[n]Father?
I can certainly try.
No can do.
What's veneration?
Pray that attitude continues on eternally.
Whether it is possible or not, your[n]attitude makes a favorable impression.
Such flippancy.
Such glib words are clearly false!
...Our Father anticipates you shall have[n]a change of heart.
If that is true, I know not the words for[n]conversing with you.
Even our magnanimous Father shall not[n]forgive those words.
If you feel the grandeur of our Father,[n]surely you too shall be saved...
You... must be tired.
It appears you require... guidance.
...I shall survive to spread the teachings[n]of our Father.
It is difficult to believe that you are[n]human...
Leading lost lambs is also my role.
...A notice from our Father has been[n]handed down.
This idiocy is your doing...
...A notice from our Father has been[n]handed down.
...Both your world and this world,[n]everything is the creation of our[n]omnipotent Father.
You, who reside in that world of the[n]almighty, what is it that has beleaguered[n]you so?
Omnipotent?
I'm not beleaguered.
There's someone I want to save.
Indeed. Meditating upon that is the first[n]step toward happiness.
...That is a good start. Such speculation[n]has great meaning.
Quite so. Your serenity lies there as well.
If you lack understanding, then I can[n]give you a thorough lesson.
...You lack the ability to relate to others,[n]don't you?
My words are those of our Father. Know[n]that you have no choice but to accept[n]them.
...I know that you are bluffing.
...Do not pretend at such stoicness. I[n]know what you truly feel.
Oh? You wish to aid those in need? An[n]admirable aim.
Our Father should look favorably upon[n]your virtuous intentions.
Spoken with weapons drawn and aimed,[n]such sentiments are hollow.
So you have seen that there is suffering[n]even in a world of the almighty?
I see. You have decided to challenge[n]this trial alone...
You need not hasten your reply.[n]Languish over your decision.
Know that such obstinacy shall keep[n]you apart from those who would offer[n]understanding.
Are you so beleaguered that you[n]cannot even open your mouth?
...You, who forgot our Father's authority[n]and became a victim of the society built[n]by impudent Man...
Think carefully. I am not the one you[n]should detest.
You're right...
That's absurd.
I'll be the judge of that.
Very good. I am grateful for your[n]wisdom.
To err is human...
The reason I appear before you is to[n]guide the way.
Ha. Could that mean you simply need a[n]little push?
Will you never discard your enmity[n]toward me?
You still do not understand the state of[n]this world.
It appears as though my words have not[n]reached you...
Do you intentionally increase the number[n]of your enemies as a self-imposed[n]trial?
Then, I shall entrust this matter to your[n]good discretion.
I feel the power granted by our Father.[n]The power of free will.
Not everything goes the way you expect...
My fate rests in your hands...
You must be... enjoying this.
For you, all that you see is your enemy...
I shall say this once more: ponder this[n]well.
Though your behavior differs, it seems[n]you are little but an impudent human[n]yourself...
...Yes, I shall be martyred here, and the[n]greatness of our Father will be spoken of[n]for all time...
I fear neither death, nor you.
In your situation?
You're tough.
Don't push yourself.
It is because my beliefs are firmly held...[n]Is that difficult for you in your youth?
Cast your eyes elsewhere, look beyond[n]yourself... That alone should suffice.
Our Father is with me... That is enough.
That... is the greatness of our Father.
Yes. Such is the power of faith.
Your threats fall far short of reaching[n]our Father...
I have more to fear in losing our Father's[n]grace.
This is but a trifle compared to the[n]greatness of our Father.
...To bear the unbearable is surely the[n]way of all life.
Surely under the circumstances, such[n]concern is empty indeed.
Can you not even discern whether my[n]words are true?
...You have a worthless eye for[n]observation, do you not?
Are you testing whether or not my[n]words are sincere?
...I respect you for fighting bravely.
I do not wish to burden you with feelings[n]of guilt over my murder.
You are quite childish. A sore loser, I[n]must say.
...Allow me to speak to you as if you[n]were a mature adult.
Out of respect for our Father, let us take[n]a moment's respite...
If that's what you want.
What are you telling me?
I'm a minor.
My... how considerate of you.
A mature negotiation... You are only[n]pretending to understand, are you not?
...You are looking for something in[n]return, I suppose?
Very considerate of you.
I did not expect such obtuseness.
That aspect of your personality is why I[n]think of you as a child.
...I do not wish to sadden our Father with[n]this needless quarrel.
You cannot make your way through[n]society with such obtuseness.
You think too little of yourself.
To realize one's own immaturity... It[n]makes a favorable impression.
Do you merely... pretend at maturity?
Haha... if so, then I can seize this[n]opportunity...
Do you intend to conclude an urgent task?
This violence is a pathetic tantrum,[n]nothing more.
...Our Father grieves.
How can you remain unperturbed, even[n]when faced with the name of our Father...?
...You have wounded me, an envoy of[n]our Father. It is inevitable that calamity[n]shall befall you.
...The least I can do is extend this small[n]mercy. Name a calamity that you can bear.
Make it crowded where I shop.
Give me violence.
No calamities, please.
...Such a secular calamity.
Hmm... So you desire to abstain from[n]material possessions, do you? That[n]makes a favorable impression.
I cannot imagine such a glib reply is[n]sincere.
I suppose that is technically calamitous,[n]but... oh, never mind.
Perhaps you favor it, but I cannot bear[n]such violence from you...
You speak as though you have grown[n]inured to suffering violence...
If that's all you desire, I can oblige you[n]personally.
Believe in our Father, and you shall[n]find the strength to bear such calamity.
Even innocent sin must be eternally[n]punished.
Stating one's intention differs from[n]simple selfishness.
As far as I'm concerned, meeting you[n]was my own calamity...
Do not be unreasonable.
My words cannot be silenced by the[n]likes of gunfire.
...I see your impatience quite clearly.
Do you panic when reality is difficult to[n]bear...? Pathetic, isn't it?
Would you prefer a more practical choice[n]than that of calamities?
...By the way, it seems like there is some[n]misunderstanding here.
That power, it originates from our Father.[n]Thus, is it not reasonable to repay him for[n]the favor?
I never considered it.
This power is all mine.
I don't know.
...Bid farewell to all that you were.
From this day forward, your[n]consciousness shall be altered.
What an impudent human... That is[n]enough.
How dare you assert your claim to that[n]power without even knowing the source[n]yourself?
...Insolent Man, how easily you fall[n]from grace.
Even though the very power you use to[n]"earn" anything is itself a gift from our[n]Father?
It seems as though you have grown[n]inebriated on the wine of narcissism.
Such arrogance... Is this the true[n]measure of human nature?
Undoubtedly, that is because our Father[n]is so close that he cannot be seen.
Could that be because the power of we[n]envoys is not equal to the task...?
Though you may not understand now,[n]the day will come when you do.
My charity is the benevolence of our[n]Father.
I see. So, such cunning artifice is the[n]product of your "civilization"...
You, who refuse to travel on the path of[n]humanity, can be considered nothing but[n]a fool.
Is this erratic behavior the result of your[n]ignorance in the ways of expressing[n]gratitude?
I am not making an unreasonable[n]demand.
...By the way, do you know the origin of[n]life? Both you and I were created by our[n]Father.
That is to say, we are brothers. There is[n]no reason for us to fight.
Leave my parents out of this.
You may be right.
But you're a Shadow.
You have no parents, save our Father.
Can you confidently bear witness to that?
Blood as family is an idea inculcated[n]upon the formation of "society."
With time, even you may come to[n]understand.
There is no doubt we are brothers.
At long last, it seems this animosity will[n]dissipate.
I shall state this plainly... Though[n]brethren, we are not equal.
Essentially, our Father and His children[n]are one and the same...
Basing conflicts on appearances or[n]bloodlines... That is a dangerous[n]ideology, would you not agree?
You say that, yet we see common[n]values that connect us both.
That, too, is a trial imposed by our[n]Father.
That is nothing more than your attempt[n]to justify your vicious acts of violence.
To think that despite our fraternity, we[n]have not the words with which to[n]converse...
As long as there is a heart that beats within[n]your chest... then we are brothers.
I shall ask our Father... Is it truly[n]forgiveness that I should grant to[n]my brother here before me?
I suppose you are perplexed, are you[n]not? If you cease this battle now, our[n]Father shall forgive you.
I see now... and so I understand all that[n]was done. Is this but a test?
You have appeared to test my adoration[n]of our Father. Yes, you are... the Tempter!
You got me.
You're mistaken.
Are you okay?
If you are truly that fiendish Tempter,[n]then I have no chance of victory.
The Tempter... The Great Adversary.[n]I have no chance of victory.
Do you despise me because I am an[n]envoy of our Father?
...I yield to your temptation.
Beguilers rarely speak the truth.
If that is the case, then how do you[n]account for my trembling?
You are not the Tempter...? Then I may[n]prove victorious after all.
An insidious intent with no sense of[n]self-awareness... I would expect no[n]less from the Tempter.
There is no need for worry. For I am under[n]the divine protection of our Father.
How vexing... To think that the Tempter[n]has shown me pity...
That depends on your approach...
Our Father would never... forsake me...
...I shall not abandon my adoration for[n]our Father.
Wait! If you are the Tempter...
You forget yourself.
Though flesh may perish, the soul lives[n]on... Do you not know this?
By the way, you are already in possession[n]of our Father's divine blessing.
What do you hope to accomplish by[n]injuring me further...?
More sleep.
Treasure.
Once I start, I can't stop.
You would sacrifice me to indulge your[n]indolence...? How despicable.
I see. Then, do you intend to send me[n]to my eternal slumber?
A choice of words that shouldn't be used[n]in the middle of battle...
Then, that attitude is likely to prove a[n]hindrance to any peaceful rest.
What you suffer from seems to be[n]more than material desire...
That is even more unforgivable!
I cannot forgive a thief blinded by his[n]own avarice!
You believe such petty baubles are worth[n]risking your life?
Does that mean you will wound me[n]endlessly?
Then do not start.
It is that very foolishness that makes Man[n]so endearing.
So, you will expose your own[n]foolishness to me?
You cannot even discover what it is you[n]hope to accomplish... That is pathetic,[n]is it not?
Human, possessed by avarice, behold[n]my resolve.
...Continue along this path and you will[n]forfeit even the divine blessing of our[n]Father.
You cannot progress while aware of your[n]own foolishness, pathetic child of Man...
...Think carefully. I am here because of[n]your desire for salvation.
For you to force me to prostrate myself,[n]as one who only seeks your well-being...[n]Is there anything more irrational?
My apologies.
I don't want salvation.
Shut up.
If you seek salvation, I can give you[n]the succor you desire.
I wish to convey the sincerity of my[n]words.
It seems you have enough of a heart to[n]confess your sins, at least.
I will not hear superficial words of regret.
If you have the time to open your[n]mouth, then use that time to improve[n]this situation.
Then how do you explain my presence[n]here?
That is an excuse to justify your[n]unreasonable actions.
I want to remove all obstacles to your[n]obedience.
Do you intend to conceal your wanton[n]acts?
Crushing an inconvenience... That, too,[n]is irrational.
Very well. I shall pray for you in silence.
I cannot say that is a good plan. You[n]have nothing to gain from my silence.
Even if you are aware of your mistake, you[n]are still too craven to acknowledge it...
One wonders how many other truths[n]could have been buried in the same[n]fashion, in your world...
To yield before wantonness, is this[n]another trial from our Father...?
Know that piling up irrational acts leads[n]either to isolation or destruction.
...I want to make something clear, so[n]I will venture to pose this question.
Do you... think me a charlatan?
I don't think that.
I think of you as a foe.
You're not one?
That is correct. I am guiding you to your[n]path of happiness.
From the way you have treated me,[n]I am not sure I should believe you...
If that is true, for what reason have[n]I received this grave injury?
I sense a hidden agenda behind your[n]words... but I will let that go.
Reconsider that. I am neither a charlatan[n]nor am I your enemy.
That is a grave misunderstanding.
I know. You did not have to put that[n]into words.
Is that to say that depending on[n]negotiations, there may be room[n]for a reconciliation?
